head: f45577cd
label: CP7_OW12A_FINANCE_CAPTURE_NATIVE7

cases.OW12A_REPORT_V2_PERIOD_COMPARISON: INCOMPLETE: product refused the same-report pair with CP7_REPORT_COMPARE_PAIR as expected; the helper's finally switched role in the aborted transaction (InFailedSqlTransaction), hiding the code from the refusal check

passed_before_the_failing_line: same_figures: capture READY, contract v2, all four snapshot parts equal to the official finance report; Report v2 case figures_equal_owner_report true
cause: Two wrong expectations in this stage's own new cases, not product: (1) finance_apply puts the source hash into every fact's refs (cp7_analysis_native.fact(amount,'IDR',refs) with refs from source_hash); the capture's hash is the sealed chunked signature (seal_hash), the direct source's hash is its one-statement scan signature, different by design, so whole fact objects differ while ids and readiness agree; (2) compare() ran SQL in finally after the refusal aborted the transaction.
fix: same_figures compares every fact without refs (state, value, unit), prints any differing metric, and asserts each side's refs cite its own source hash; compare() skips the role reset when the transaction is aborted (the refusal helper rolls back and restores the role). No product line changed.
